# Keys and editing targets {#sec-key-reference}

This is a compact reference to the default bindings. It complements the
explanations in the chapters. `, ?` is the complete live list for the current
view, focus and custom bindings; prefixes and operators also offer contextual
hint menus. A sequence written without spaces is typed one key at a time.

## Views and discovery

| Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ga`, `gr`, `ge`, `gc` | Arrangement, piano roll, event list, conductor |
| `gt`, `gm`; `gs` in the arrangement | Tracks, Ports; section strip |
| `gl` / Escape | Enter the piano roll's lane / return to notes |
| Backspace | Previous view |
| Ctrl-PageDown / Ctrl-PageUp | Next / previous track |
| Ctrl-P, `, :` | Command palette |
| `, ?` | Keys available here |
| `:` | Named command line |
| Escape | Cancel waiting keys, a prompt or a selection |

## Movement and screen scale

| Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `h` `j` `k` `l`, arrows | Left, down, up, right in the current view |
| `gg` / `G` | Start / end; a count chooses a bar or strip section |
| `0` / `$` | First / last position appropriate to the view |
| `[b` / `]b` | Previous / next bar line |
| `{` / `}` | Same position a bar earlier / later |
| `[s` / `]s`, `[l` / `]l` | Previous / next section, label |
| Tab / Shift-Tab | Next / previous note, event in a lane, or occupied arrangement bar |
| `(` / `)` | Previous / next chord |
| Up / Down (or `k` / `j`); `K` / `J` | Piano-roll semitone movement; octave movement |
| `g` then Up / Down, or `gk` / `gj` | Move up / down within the chord |
| `gp` | Go to a pitch row by pitch, MIDI number or drum name |
| `za`, `zF` | Toggle pitch folding, choose which rows and scope to show |
| `zP` | Toggle Always show for the current pitch in the drum map |
| `:select pitch PITCH` | Select the pitch row across the track |
| `zi`, `zo`, `z0` | Zoom in, out, reset |
| `z` then Left / Right (or `zh` / `zl`), Ctrl-T | Finer / coarser editing grid, triplets |
| `zz`, `zf` | Centre cursor, resume following playback |
| Ctrl-D / Ctrl-U | Half a page down / up |
| Ctrl-F / Ctrl-B | A page down / up |
| Ctrl with directions | Move and scroll together |
| Ctrl-Shift-Left / Ctrl-Shift-Right, or Ctrl-Shift-H / Ctrl-Shift-L | A horizontal page |

`0` and `$` are bar start/last step in the piano roll, song first/last bar
in the arrangement, and first/last field in an event-list row. They are not
interchangeable with `gg` and `G` in every view.

## Operators and objects

The general form is `[count] operator [count] target`. A target is a range
or an object. In Visual mode the selection already supplies it.

| Operator | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `d`, `y` | Delete, yank |
| `>`, `<` | Transpose up, down |
| `t`, `T` | Shift later, earlier |
| `q`, `^`, `~` | Quantise, velocity, humanise |
| `!` | Choose a transform after the target |

| Object | On a track | On the section strip |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in` | Note or event under the cursor | — |
| `ic` | Chord, in piano roll/event list | — |
| `ib` | This bar's event contents | — |
| `ab` | This bar as time; not in event list | — |
| `is` | This section's events on this track | Section's events on every track |
| `as` | — | Section itself |
| `it` | Track's events | — |
| `ie` | — | Entire song's events |
| `gn` | Current or next search match | — |

Doubling an operator normally supplies the track's current bar: `dd`, `>>`,
`qq`. An amount before transposition or shifting describes how far; after
it, a count describes the target's extent. For other operators, before and
after counts multiply.

## Selections, copies and history

| Keys | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `v`, `V`, Ctrl-V | Time band, whole rows, box in timeline views |
| `o` in Visual mode | Swap active end/corner |
| `gv` | Restore last selection |
| `D` on suitable Visual time | Remove time within sections |
| `|` | Cut crossing notes at target edges |
| `p`, `P` | Merge/insert events; replace a Visual target; after/before on strip |
| Alt-p / Alt-P | Piano-roll put at cursor pitch too |
| `"a`, `"A` | Use register a, append to a |
| `u`, Ctrl-R, `.` | Undo, redo, repeat last change |
| `Qa` … `Q`, `@a`, `@@` | Record macro a, play it, replay last macro |

## Notes, lanes and fields

| Keys | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `o`, `O` in notes | Add a note, add and advance |
| `, e` | Choose a non-note event type and enter its fields |
| `, n` | Default note from the current note |
| `x`, `Y` | Delete / yank current note or event |
| Alt with directions | Move a note or suitable lane event |
| Alt-Shift-Left / Alt-Shift-Right, or `Alt-H` / `Alt-L` | Nudge an event in time |
| `=` / `-`, `+` / `_` in notes | Grid end adjustment, fine length adjustment |
| Ctrl-A / Ctrl-X | Step velocity or a numeric field |
| `e`, Enter | Inspector editor, or current field as appropriate |
| `, c c`, `[c`, `]c` | Choose lane, previous/next controller |
| `, c v` | Pedal regions / values |
| `, c h` | Lane height: three rows, a quarter, half |
| Number then Enter in a lane | Set or insert a value |
| `, c r`, `, c R` | Ramp the lane's controller; turn a ramp into events |
| `, c s`, `, c l`, `, c i` | Scale, limit, invert controller values, then a range or object |
| `, c m`, `, c u` | Smooth controller values, remove exact repeats, then a range or object |
| `, x K s/l/i/m/u` | The same controller transforms from the transform menu |
| `, c x` or `, x x` in a continuous lane | Reverse a complete, known held-value contour, then a time target |
| `, x m` | Remap controllers, notes or program-change events, then a target |
| `=` `-` `+` `_` on a ramp | Move its end by a grid step / nudge |

## In an open inspector

| Keys | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Enter | Set the field and stay on it; on a button, press it |
| Tab / Shift-Tab | Set the field, go to the next / previous field or button |
| Up / Down | Step the value or choice |
| Enter or Alt-Down on a choice | Open its list |
| Ctrl-Enter | Keep every change, as one undo step |
| Escape | Put back what was typed; then cancel the draft |

## Tracks, sections and transport

| Keys | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `, t a`, `, t i`, `, t d`, `, t r` | Add, insert, delete, rename tracks |
| `, t y`, `, t p`, `, t P`, `, t D` | Yank, put after/before, duplicate whole tracks |
| `p`, `P` holding whole tracks | Put them as new tracks after/before |
| `, t o`, Alt-Up / Alt-Down | Reorder tracks, move immediately |
| `M`, `S`, `A` | Mute, solo, arm the current track |
| `, t c`, `, t q`, `, t f` | Chase notes, playback quantise, freeze |
| `, t k` | Choose or review the track's drum map (**k** for kit) |
| `, s r`, `, s i`, `, s a`, `, s j` | Rename, insert before/after, join sections |
| `, s s`, `, s l`, `, s f` | Split at bar, label to section, follow meter |
| `, b i`, `, b d`, `, b m` | Song-bar insert/delete, meter or Visual rebar |
| Space, Shift-Space | Play/stop, stop and return |
| `m` then Space, Ctrl-Space | Set play-from marker, set it and play |
| `R`, `, r m`, `, r t` | Record, replace/overdub, track Thru |
| `, r A` | Disarm every armed track |
| `, l l`, `, l d`, `, l s` | Add, delete a label; section from a label |
| `, l m`, `, l x` | List marks, delete marks by name |
| `, m m`, `, m c`, `, m s` | Click mode, lead-in mode, Metronome page |
| `, f f`, `, f o`, `, f n` | Open a file, switch open songs, new song |
| `, f s`, `, f S`, `, f c`, `, f x` | Save, save as, close the song, export MIDI |
| `, f i` | Import tracks from a file, ticking which |
| `]f` / `[f`, Ctrl-Tab / Ctrl-Shift-Tab | Next / previous open song, going round |
| Ctrl-. | Panic |

The section strip's single keys differ from the track commands: `i` and
`a` insert sections, `c` renames, `J` joins, and `+`/`-` change length.
Down (or `j`) moves back down to the tracks. Section reordering uses
`Alt-h` / `Alt-l`, or Alt-Left / Alt-Right. The text chapters explain these
contextual meanings.

## Search and memory

| Keys or command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `f` / `F` and a pitch class | Find forwards / backwards |
| `;`, Alt-; | Repeat find, reverse its direction |
| `/`, `n`, `N`, `*`, `#` | Query, next/previous match, search current pitch |
| `gn` after an operator | Act on a match and advance |
| `, S b/s/t/v` | Select bar/section/track/visible material |
| `, S B/S/T/V` | Select only matches in that scope |
| `, S m`, `, S c` | Keep matches in selection, clear search |
| `ma`, `'a`, `''` | Set mark a, visit it, return before last jump |
| `:marks`, `:registers`, `:macros` | Inspect remembered places/material/actions |

Slashes between letters in this table describe alternatives, not literal
slashes to type. For example, `, S b/s/t/v` means choose one of those four
letters after `, S`.

Marks, named registers and macros each have their own independent `a`–`z`
names. Upper-case register and macro recording names append to the
corresponding lower-case name; marks use lower-case names.
